title_sq: Ne Komunen E Parisit, Shitet Super Apartament 2+1+2, Totalisht I Investuar !!
description_sq: Ne Komunen E Parisit, Shitet Super Apartament 2+1+2, Totalisht I Investuar !! Apartamenti me siperfaqe 99 m2 ndodhet ne katin e 4 te nje ndertimi te ri te mireadministruar dhe me ashensor, ne zemer te Komunes se Parisit. Organizohet nga hyrja me korridor, salloni i ndenjes i lidhur me kendin e gatimit dhe pjesen e ngrenies, dy dhoma gjumi te bollshme dhe dy tualete . Orientimi i apartamentit eshte perfekt Jug-Perendim cka i mundeson ndricim natyral gjate gjithe dites. Apartamenti eshte i sapo investuar nga e para, duke perfshire instalimet elektrike, hidraulike, mobilim modern, kondicionim inverter, parket Ac5, vetrata termike me vlere rreth 45.000 euro. Ofrohen te gjitha facilitetet per nje jetese komode si prezenca e supermarketeve, bankave, farmacive, transporti publik etj. Prona disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor.
title_en: In the Municipality of Paris, Super Apartment 2+1+2 for sale, Totally Invested!!
description_en: In the Municipality of Paris, Super Apartment 2+1+2 for sale, Totally Invested!! The apartment with an area of ​​99 m2 is located on the 4th floor of a new, well-managed building with an elevator, in the heart of the Commune of Paris. It is organized by the entrance with a corridor, the living room connected to the kitchen corner and the dining area, two spacious bedrooms and two bathrooms. The orientation of the apartment is perfect South-West, which allows natural light throughout the day. The apartment has just been invested from scratch, including electrical installations, plumbing, modern furniture, inverter air conditioning, Ac5 parquet, thermal windows with a value of about 45,000 euros. All the facilities for a comfortable life are offered, such as the presence of supermarkets, banks, pharmacies, public transport, etc. The property has regular mortgage documentation.
